bio.text: Nicole Klarides-Ditria has represented the 105th House District, which covers Beacon Falls, Seymour and part of Derby, since she was first elected in 2016.
She was elected to the Seymour Board of Selectmen in 2011 and became Deputy First Selectman before stepping down after her 2016 election to the House.
She is a graduate of Quinnipiac University and a certified athletic trainer; according to the page, she is head athletic trainer at Lauralton Hall High School in Milford.
She is a lifelong resident of Seymour.
